feed.title: Orvay Status
feed.subtitle: Changes to what we measure. Nothing is published here unless a state actually changed.

entry.title: Agent routines: a fault in our own checking, not in the service
entry.content: This row started being checked on 28 November. Its first check ran a few minutes before the background job it reads had run once since the update, so it read as degraded until the next run of that job. Nothing had stopped. We recorded Agent routines changing from degraded to operational at 2026-11-28T13:07:22.193Z, and that reading was our own, so the entry is kept and corrected rather than deleted.
